description: Is Private DNS for VPCs answering, and is configuration reaching it? Covers the resolvers at fd53::53 and fd53::54, the serving fleet, the control plane that compiles contexts, private zone readiness and broker delivery.

panels.description: Serving replicas that are not available: node resolvers, regional routers, regional CoreDNS and public recursors. Readiness checks the listener address, the activated configuration and local DNS over UDP and TCP, so an unavailable member is not answering.
panels.title: Serving replicas down

panels.description: Control-plane replicas available to compile contexts and publish configuration.
panels.title: Control plane up

panels.description: Share of runs that failed in the last hour, for the worst control-plane loop. Each loop retries, so a few percent is noise; a loop near 100% cannot make progress. Loops with fewer than 10 runs in the hour are left out so one failure cannot read as 50%. Broker reads are left out because they wait for messages. Once the control plane reports conflicts on their own, update conflicts between the two replicas no longer count as failures.

targets.expr: (max(((sum by (loop, region, shard) (increase(internal_dns_loop_runs_total{namespace="internal-dns-system",loop!="ack read",result="error"}[1h])) or 0 * sum by (loop, region, shard) (increase(internal_dns_loop_runs_total{namespace="internal-dns-system",loop!="ack read"}[1h]))) / sum by (loop, region, shard) (increase(internal_dns_loop_runs_total{namespace="internal-dns-system",loop!="ack read"}[1h]))) and on (loop, region, shard) sum by (loop, region, shard) (increase(internal_dns_loop_runs_total{namespace="internal-dns-system",loop!="ack read"}[1h])) >= 10)) or (max(((sum by (operation) (increase(internal_dns_operations_total{namespace="internal-dns-system",operation!~"ack read .*",result="error"}[1h])) or 0 * sum by (operation) (increase(internal_dns_operations_total{namespace="internal-dns-system",operation!~"ack read .*"}[1h]))) / sum by (operation) (increase(internal_dns_operations_total{namespace="internal-dns-system",operation!~"ack read .*"}[1h]))) and on (operation) sum by (operation) (increase(internal_dns_operations_total{namespace="internal-dns-system",operation!~"ack read .*"}[1h])) >= 10)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Worst loop error rate

panels.description: Time since the slowest periodic control-plane loop last succeeded on any replica. Acknowledgement steps only run when a member reports, so they are left out.

targets.expr: max(min by (loop, region, shard) (time() - internal_dns_loop_last_success_timestamp_seconds{namespace="internal-dns-system",loop!~"ack (read|apply|commit)"})) or max(min by (operation) (time() - internal_dns_operation_last_success_timestamp_seconds{namespace="internal-dns-system",operation!~"ack (read|apply|commit) .*"}))

panels.title: Stalest loop

panels.description: Private zones whose Programmed condition is not true in their project. A pending zone answers SERVFAIL beneath its apex while the context keeps serving its other zones. A zone whose network has no serving members in its region stays pending; the table under Private zones and records lists each one with its reason.

targets.expr: (count((dns_zone_status_condition{condition="Programmed"} and on ("milo.project.name", namespace, name) dns_zone_info{visibility="Private"}) != 1) or vector(0)) and on () count(dns_zone_info{visibility!=""})

panels.title: Private zones pending

panels.description: Fewest messages over the last 5 minutes that the most backed-up configuration consumer had not yet received: member publication and record consumers, and the control plane acknowledgement reader. Members keep serving their applied configuration while this is above zero, but changes are not reaching them. Member acknowledgement readers are left out: every member reads every heartbeat, and a new member replays the last day of history. They are under Configuration delivery.
panels.title: Config backlog

panels.description: Queries each dnsdist front received: the node resolvers at fd53::53 and fd53::54 and the regional routers. Only members with dnsdist metrics turned on report.
panels.title: Queries per resolver

panels.description: What the resolvers sent back to clients. NXDOMAIN is expected for names outside a project. SERVFAIL means a backend failed or did not answer in time. A query can pass through more than one tier, so the tiers do not add up to a client total.
panels.title: Answers by response code

panels.description: Histogram estimates for answered UDP frontend queries, by cluster and tier. Buckets end at 1, 10, 50, 100 and 1000 ms, then +Inf. Interpolation can show 0.5 ms without measuring that exact latency; a quantile in +Inf is capped at 1000 ms, not a measured one-second answer. Includes UDP error responses, readiness and background traffic; excludes TCP frontend answers and unanswered queries. The histogram has no response-code label: use Answers by response code separately. At low volume, one or two tail answers can move p99 sharply; compare the UDP band shares and counts below.
panels.title: UDP answer time (estimated p50 and p99)

panels.description: Queries a backend did not answer in time, could not be sent to a backend, or were dropped by an access rule or for lack of a backend. Clients retry, so a short burst usually shows up as slow answers rather than failures.
panels.title: Unanswered and dropped queries

panels.description: Share of queries each dnsdist front sent to CoreDNS over an already open TCP connection. Near 100% means connections are reused; a drop means each query is paying for a new connection.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, internal_dns_datum_net_tier, pod) (rate(dnsdist_server_tcpreusedconnections{container="dnsdist",internal_dns_datum_net_tier=~"node|node-b|regional-dnsdist"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (cluster, internal_dns_datum_net_tier, pod) (rate(dnsdist_server_tcpreusedconnections{container="dnsdist",internal_dns_datum_net_tier=~"node|node-b|regional-dnsdist"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (cluster, internal_dns_datum_net_tier, pod) (rate(dnsdist_server_tcpnewconnections{container="dnsdist",internal_dns_datum_net_tier=~"node|node-b|regional-dnsdist"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Backend connection reuse

panels.description: CPU each serving pod used, in cores, split by container: dnsdist (the resolver front), serving (CoreDNS), agent (receives and activates configuration) and recursor (public recursion). The pod name carries the tier: node, node-b, regional-front, regional-coredns or public-recursor.
panels.title: Serving CPU by container, cores

panels.description: Questions each public recursor pod received per second.
panels.title: Recursor queries

panels.description: Share of answers in each time band, across the recursor pods. Answers from cache land under 1 ms; anything over 100 ms waited on an authoritative server.
panels.title: Recursor answer time, share of answers

panels.description: Moving average of the time each recursor pod took to answer, as the recursor reports it.
panels.title: Recursor average answer time

panels.description: What the public recursors sent back. NXDOMAIN is normal for names that do not exist; SERVFAIL means the recursor could not get an answer.
panels.title: Recursor answers by response code

panels.description: Share of questions each recursor pod answered with SERVFAIL. A rise usually means an upstream or authoritative server is failing.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, pod) (rate(pdns_recursor_servfail_answers{internal_dns_datum_net_tier="public-recursor"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (cluster, pod) (rate(pdns_recursor_questions{internal_dns_datum_net_tier="public-recursor"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Recursor SERVFAIL share

panels.description: Queries the recursor sent out that timed out or could not be sent, queries it dropped because it was at capacity or a resource limit, and answers that failed DNSSEC validation.
panels.title: Recursor upstream problems

panels.description: Share of lookups each recursor pod answered from its cache.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, pod) (rate(pdns_recursor_cache_hits{internal_dns_datum_net_tier="public-recursor"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (cluster, pod) (rate(pdns_recursor_cache_hits{internal_dns_datum_net_tier="public-recursor"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (cluster, pod) (rate(pdns_recursor_cache_misses{internal_dns_datum_net_tier="public-recursor"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Recursor cache hit ratio

panels.description: Entries in each pod's record cache (left axis) and queries it is resolving right now (right axis). Queries in flight that keep climbing mean the recursor is waiting on slow upstreams.
panels.title: Recursor cache size and queries in flight

panels.description: CPU in cores (left axis) and working set memory (right axis) of each recursor container. A pod near its CPU limit answers late.
panels.title: Recursor CPU and memory

panels.description: Available replicas of each serving deployment at each location. A member that drops to zero is out of the regional pool or, for the node resolver, out of service for its node.
panels.title: Available replicas per member

panels.description: Serving pods failing readiness. Readiness stays local to the pod, so this reflects the member and not the consumer path through Galactic.
panels.title: Serving pods not ready

panels.description: Container restarts in serving pods. CoreDNS restarts during activation are expected; repeated restarts of one container are not.
panels.title: Serving container restarts

panels.description: Working set memory of each serving pod, split by container. A container that climbs toward its limit is killed and restarted.
panels.title: Serving memory by container

panels.description: Completed runs of each control-plane loop. A successful run can be idle; it does not prove that an endpoint is serving.
panels.title: Loop runs by result

panels.description: Failed runs per loop. Planner and outbox errors stop configuration reaching the fleet; acknowledgement errors stop status reaching projects.
panels.title: Loop errors

panels.description: Age of the latest successful run of each loop, across control-plane replicas. Acknowledgement reads advance only when a member reports.
panels.title: Time since last success

panels.description: Reconciles of project resources across every source project. Each project runs its own controller, so they are summed here.
panels.title: Project reconciles by result

panels.description: Slowest 1% of project passes, and the slowest pass, read as the upper bound of its histogram bucket. Every pass reads the source project API directly, so this follows project API latency. On builds without internal_dns_project_pass_seconds both lines stop at 60 s.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(internal_dns_project_pass_seconds_bucket{namespace="internal-dns-system"}[$__rate_interval]))) or histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(controller_runtime_reconcile_time_seconds_bucket{namespace="internal-dns-system",controller=~"internal-dns-control-plane-.*"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(1, sum by (le) (rate(internal_dns_project_pass_seconds_bucket{namespace="internal-dns-system"}[$__rate_interval]))) or histogram_quantile(1, sum by (le) (rate(controller_runtime_reconcile_time_seconds_bucket{namespace="internal-dns-system",controller=~"internal-dns-control-plane-.*"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Project pass time, p99 and slowest

panels.description: Project reconciles waiting, summed across projects. A queue that keeps growing means changes are not being compiled.
panels.title: Reconcile queue depth

panels.description: Private zones across every project.
panels.title: Private zones

targets.expr: (count(((dns_record_set_status_condition{condition="Programmed"} * on ("milo.project.name", namespace, name) group_left (dns_zone_name) dns_record_set_info) and on ("milo.project.name", namespace, dns_zone_name) label_replace(dns_zone_info{visibility="Private"}, "dns_zone_name", "$1", "name", "(.*)"))) or vector(0)) and on () count(dns_zone_info{visibility!=""})

targets.expr: (count(((dns_record_set_status_condition{condition="Programmed"} * on ("milo.project.name", namespace, name) group_left (dns_zone_name) dns_record_set_info) and on ("milo.project.name", namespace, dns_zone_name) label_replace(dns_zone_info{visibility="Private"}, "dns_zone_name", "$1", "name", "(.*)")) != 1) or vector(0)) and on () count(dns_zone_info{visibility!=""})

panels.description: Networks in a region whose DNSReady condition is not true, leaving out networks with nothing attached, with DNS turned off, or being deleted. A network in a region with no Private DNS serving members stays Pending. Workloads on these networks cannot resolve private names through fd53::53 and fd53::54. The table next to private zones lists each one with its reason.

targets.expr: count((datum_cloud_network_context_status_condition{condition="DNSReady",reason!~"NoAttachments|NoAttachedWorkloads|Disabled|Terminating"} != 1) and on ("milo.project.name", namespace, name, reason, status) (timestamp(datum_cloud_network_context_status_condition{condition="DNSReady"}) >= on ("milo.project.name", namespace, name) group_left () max by ("milo.project.name", namespace, name) (timestamp(datum_cloud_network_context_status_condition{condition="DNSReady"})))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Networks not DNS-ready

panels.description: Every private zone whose Programmed condition is not true, with its reason.
panels.title: Private zones not programmed

panels.description: Every network in a region whose DNSReady condition is a fault, with its reason. Networks with nothing attached, with DNS turned off, or being deleted are left out.

targets.expr: (datum_cloud_network_context_status_condition{condition="DNSReady",reason!~"NoAttachments|NoAttachedWorkloads|Disabled|Terminating"} != 1) and on ("milo.project.name", namespace, name, reason, status) (timestamp(datum_cloud_network_context_status_condition{condition="DNSReady"}) >= on ("milo.project.name", namespace, name) group_left () max by ("milo.project.name", namespace, name) (timestamp(datum_cloud_network_context_status_condition{condition="DNSReady"})))

panels.description: Worst time in each interval from a record write to the first answer from the VPC resolver, by test scenario and step. Bars on the right axis count changes that were never answered.

panels.description: Worst per-second p99 of load test queries in each interval, by scenario and query kind, taken from the generator with the slowest answers. Timeouts count as 5000 ms.

panels.description: Average queries per second the load test sent, and failed queries per second, across all generators, by scenario and query kind.

panels.description: Shares from measured histogram bucket counts, without quantile interpolation: under 1 ms, over 100 ms and over 1 s. Thresholds overlap: over 1 s is a subset of over 100 ms; the lines do not sum to 100%. The denominator is the same UDP histogram population, including error and background answers, not all-protocol queries. Empty when no UDP answers were observed; missing telemetry stays empty.

targets.expr: (clamp_min((sum by (cluster, internal_dns_datum_net_tier) (increase(dnsdist_latency_count{container="dnsdist",internal_dns_datum_net_tier=~"node|node-b|regional-dnsdist"}[$__rate_interval]))) - (sum by (cluster, internal_dns_datum_net_tier) (increase(dnsdist_latency_bucket{container="dnsdist",internal_dns_datum_net_tier=~"node|node-b|regional-dnsdist",le="100"}[$__rate_interval]))), 0)) / (sum by (cluster, internal_dns_datum_net_tier) (increase(dnsdist_latency_count{container="dnsdist",internal_dns_datum_net_tier=~"node|node-b|regional-dnsdist"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

(clamp_min((sum by (cluster, internal_dns_datum_net_tier) (increase(dnsdist_latency_count{container="dnsdist",internal_dns_datum_net_tier=~"node|node-b|regional-dnsdist"}[$__rate_interval]))) - (sum by (cluster, internal_dns_datum_net_tier) (increase(dnsdist_latency_bucket{container="dnsdist",internal_dns_datum_net_tier=~"node|node-b|regional-dnsdist",le="1000"}[$__rate_interval]))), 0)) / (sum by (cluster, internal_dns_datum_net_tier) (increase(dnsdist_latency_count{container="dnsdist",internal_dns_datum_net_tier=~"node|node-b|regional-dnsdist"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: UDP answers by latency threshold, share

panels.description: Rolling counts over the same Grafana rate interval as the percentile chart: all UDP histogram answers on the right axis, over 100 ms and over 1 s on the left. Slow counts subtract finite buckets from that same population. A large p99 alongside only one or two slow answers is different from sustained high-volume latency. Counts may be fractional because increase() can extrapolate between scrapes; they are not packet-level event logs. Zero means a sampled counter did not increase, while missing telemetry stays empty. Includes error responses; see Answers by response code for their separate breakdown.
